title: cc-insights CLI 宣传片
description: 43s 终端风宣传片：痛点证据→finding→rec/tok/cmd/web 快速下钻→AI 可消费输出→CTA。

env.fonts: local: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font + Noto Sans CJK SC (零联网)
env.audio_voice: mmx Chinese (Mandarin)_Male_Announcer / speech-2.8-hd, public/script-52s.txt → voiceover-52s.mp3/srt，实际语音 42.6s
env.audio_bgm: mix-cc-insights-52s.m4a 内含人声+BGM，render-final.sh 按视频长度 trim 到 43.17s
env.audio_captions: voiceover-52s.srt / KaraokeCaptions 保留给可选字幕版；主推版不挂载全片字幕

renders.command: TS=20260704-ccopt END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
TS=20260704-manim2 END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized

renders.command: TS=20260704-nocaptions END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized
renders.captions: disabled in CCInsightsPromo to keep Manim titles and screenshot annotations clean

renders.command: TS=20260704-cutfix2 END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized
fixes: rec -> tok uses a hard cut instead of crossfade to avoid stacking two dense UI scenes
SceneRec masks the lower Manim metrics rail so the 20s frame only carries the core four-step chain

renders.command: TS=20260704-overlayfix END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized
fixes: SceneRec masks the Manim title area so the right panel no longer repeats the left-side copy
SceneTok removes the red explanatory badge from the screenshot and keeps only the filter-condition outline
SceneCmd replaces the failure-rate text badge with a thin screenshot outline
SceneWeb removes the teal explanatory badge from the dashboard screenshot and keeps only the table outline
check_frames: 19.0s: rec chain has no repeated title
27.0s/30.0s: web/cost screenshot has no overlaid explanatory text

renders.command: TS=20260704-rec18fix END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized
fixes: SceneRec scales and raises the embedded Manim chain so the 18s frame reads as the main panel content
SceneRec reduces the lower mask from 330px to 190px so it hides only the metric rail instead of flattening the lower half of the panel
SceneRec keeps the top mask to prevent the Manim title from duplicating the left-side narrative copy
check_frames: 18.0s: rec chain is enlarged and no longer appears as a thin strip in an over-masked panel

renders.command: TS=20260704-framefix END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized
fixes: SceneTok tightens the 23s outline to the filter-condition row only, avoiding the table header
SceneCmd changes the 24s outline from a narrow failure-rate column box to a row-level box over echo/grep, covering command, calls, failures, and failure rate
check_frames: 23.0s: tok outline covers only the filter condition row
24.0s/24.5s: cmd outline covers echo and grep rows without floating over blank table space

renders.command: TS=20260704-rec-clean END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized
fixes: RecChain Manim source removes the metric rail and bottom conclusion text so 19s/20s no longer contain overlapping right-panel labels
SceneRec removes the lower Remotion mask because the Manim source no longer needs metric-rail hiding
README scene ranges are corrected to exact frame-derived times, including rec ending at 20.500s and tok starting at frame 615
check_frames: 18.0s: rec chain is visible without lower-panel masking artifacts
19.0s: right panel has no overlapping metric labels
20.0s: right panel remains clean before the hard cut

renders.command: TS=20260704-tokbox END_FRAME_OFFSET=0 CONCURRENCY=4 JOBS=1 CHUNK_FRAMES=600 pnpm --dir remotion render
renders.audio: aac stereo 48kHz, same mix as final-optimized
fixes: SceneTok moves the filter-condition outline from top=122 height=32 to top=116 height=30 so the 20.5s-23s box surrounds the text row without crossing it
check_frames: 21.0s: tok outline sits outside the filter-condition text and does not touch the table header
23.0s: tok outline remains aligned before the transition into cmd

reproduce.still_check: render-final.sh auto extracts frames 20, 7s, middle, 3/4, final

notes: 2026-07-04 优化：总长 52.7s→43.17s，按 voiceover-52s.srt 重排场景起点，并给 tok/web 截图增加焦点标注。Manim 混合版把 hook 的 JSONL→finding 和 rec 的证据链预渲染为本地 mp4，再用 Remotion Video 嵌入；试过 OffthreadVideo，但本地渲染吞吐明显偏低，因此改用 Video。无字幕主推版移除全片顶部 KaraokeCaptions，避免和 Manim 标题、截图标注争夺顶部层级；SRT/组件保留给可选 captioned 版本。20-21s 修复：rec→tok 改硬切。19s/22s/24.5s/27s 覆核后清理截图和 Manim 面板上的解释性文字贴片：图内只保留框线/高亮，叙事文字统一放左侧文案区。18s 覆核后修正 rec 面板：嵌入 Manim 链路放大并上移。23s/24s 覆核后收紧标注框：tok 只圈过滤条件行，cmd 改为横向圈住 echo/grep 两行。再次核对 19s 后，RecChain Manim 源素材删除底部 metric rail 和结论文字，SceneRec 删除底部遮罩；最终片 18s/19s/20s 均无右侧重叠。README 分镜表改为精确帧时间：rec 为 15.333–20.500s，tok 从 20.500s/frame 615 开始。再次核对 20.5–23s 后，SceneTok 过滤条件框调整为 top=116 height=30，最终片 21s/23s 框线不压文字且不碰表头。最新主推输出为 renders/final/cc-insights-promo_20260704-tokbox_final.mp4。durationInFrames = Σ场景1355 − Σ转场60 = 1295。配色/缓动/字体常量在 src/theme.ts。
